arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status != 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status != 'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights

SELECT 'pending_booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'key',idempotency_key,'state',state,'created_step',created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'totals',json_object('bookings',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings),'confirmed',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed'),'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds),'charges_by_state',(SELECT json_group_object(state,n) FROM (SELECT state,count(*) AS n FROM charges GROUP BY state)),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins),'outbox_by_status',(SELECT json_group_object(status,n) FROM (SELECT status,count(*) AS n FROM outbox GROUP BY status)),'refunds',(SELECT count(*) FROM refunds)) UNION ALL SELECT 'payment_log',json_object('path',path,'status',status,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service='payment' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12)

SELECT b.booking_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,c.charge_id,c.state AS charge_state,c.amount_cents AS charged_cents,r.amount_cents AS refunded_cents,(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) AS holds,(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins ci WHERE ci.booking_id=b.booking_id) AS checkins,(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id AND e.kind='cancel') AS cancel_events FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.charge_id=c.charge_id WHERE b.status='cancelled'
